patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used, pairing large, high-quality imagery with concise text blocks, often with the image occupying more horizontal space than the text.
A strong typographic contrast is established between large, elegant serif headings and clean, highly legible sans-serif body text, creating a sophisticated and authoritative voice.
The site uses a refined, earthy color palette featuring a dominant dark forest green and a warm off-white/beige, accented by a subtle, warm tan for highlights and specific textual elements.

The cookie consent banner remains sticky to the bottom-right of the viewport, maintaining its position as the user scrolls, while main content sections scroll into view without complex entrance animations.
Content sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and alternating background colors (dark green and warm off-white), providing a clear visual rhythm and hierarchy.

technique_notes: A fixed-position element is anchored to the bottom right of the viewport, ensuring it remains visible and accessible during vertical scrolling. Content sections are presented in a standard linear flow, appearing sequentially as the user scrolls down the page without additional scroll-triggered reveals or animations beyond the default browser behavior.
The hero section utilizes a full-width background image or video (as hinted by 'video-hero') with a simple text overlay, establishing a strong visual presence without complex interactive elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with clean, legible sans-serif body text and small uppercase labels for navigation and metadata.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — all elements, images, and buttons feature crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical spacing between sections and ample padding within content blocks create a sense of openness and luxury.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its sophisticated blend of classic serif typography with a modern, clean layout and a muted, earthy color palette. This combination, paired with large, high-quality project imagery, creates an authoritative yet elegant brand presence that feels both timeless and contemporary.
